label: Pairwise wfmash (two-pass)
description: Per-pair wfmash alignment with Pass A (-s 100k sensitive) + Pass B (-s 500k backbone). Divergence-tiered identity (p90/85/80/skip).

label: Per-PAF breakpoint event extraction
description: Walk PAF blocks per query chromosome; emit NONCOLLINEAR/INVERSION/INTERCHROM/INVERTED_TRANSLOC events with --min-mapq 1.

label: Cluster events into zones per anchor
description: Cluster per-pair breakpoint events across pairs into zones with confidence tiers and backbone_support from Pass B.

label: Both-anchor reciprocity (BP3c)
description: Cross-validate zones from Cgar anchor vs Cmac anchor; emit reciprocity_table.tsv of zones supported from both directions.

label: BP5 atlas data + PAF arcs (figure prep)
description: Prepare atlas_data.json + atlas_paf_arcs.json for the BP5 figure layer (ribbons, dotplots, montage).

label: BP6 joint A-E classification
description: Combine zone + reciprocity evidence into a single A-E classification per breakpoint (manuscript-table ready).

label: Gene-order breakpoint extraction
description: Extract breakpoint edges from macrosyntR wide ortholog tables (18sp + 5sp). Independent method family from wfmash sequence alignment.

label: Tolerance-cluster consolidation + cross-method flag
description: Consolidate breakpoints across methods (gene_order vs wfmash sequence) with tolerance-cluster sweep 500kb -> 1kb. cross_method flag = TRUE only when both method families agree within tolerance.

label: BP_ATLAS chain (sequence method, full)
description: Chain pairwise_wfmash_two_pass -> breakpoint_events -> breakpoint_zones -> breakpoint_reciprocity -> breakpoint_paf_arcs -> breakpoint_joint_classify. Two-pass wfmash + zone clustering + both-anchor reciprocity + figure prep + A-E classification.

label: Gene-order + cross-method chain
description: Chain gene_order_breakpoints -> gene_order_cluster_consolidation. Independent gene-order detection family that consolidates against bp_atlas_pipeline outputs to produce the cross-method-validated headline catalogue.
